title: Assistant Director (OG-2)
education: Master's or Bachelor's Degree in Economics, Business Administration, Public Administration, Commerce, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or Computer Science from HEC recognized institution.
experience: Fresh Graduates Eligible (Age relaxation as per SBP rules)
description: Selected candidates will undergo rigorous training and will be posted at SBP Head Office or field offices across Pakistan, handling monetary policy, banking supervision, or economic research.
requirements: Minimum 16 years of education from an HEC recognized university.
Maximum age limit is 26 years as of the deadline (relaxable as per rules).
Passing of SBP written test and panel interview is mandatory.

title: Director / Deputy Director (BPS-18/19)
education: Second Class or Grade 'C' Master's Degree or equivalent qualification.
experience: 5 Years post-qualification experience in relevant administrative or technical field.
description: Responsible for managing administrative affairs, policy formulation, and departmental coordination at federal ministries in Islamabad.
requirements: Pakistani national holding valid CNIC.
Age limit: 25-35 years plus general relaxation as per rules.
Must apply online through the official FPSC portal before the deadline.

title: Provincial Management Service (PMS) Officer
education: Bachelor's Degree (at least 2nd Division) from a recognized university.
description: PMS officers serve in various administrative capacities across Punjab districts, managing civil administration, revenue, and public service delivery.
requirements: Both male, female, and transgender candidates holding domicile of Punjab are eligible.
Age limit ranges from 21 to 30 years.
Competitive written examination conducted by PPSC followed by psychological assessment and viva voce.

title: Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead
education: BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent.
experience: 4-6 Years of professional software development experience.
description: Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications for global clients using modern cloud and backend technologies.
requirements: Strong proficiency in enterprise frameworks (Java, .NET Core, Node.js, or React).
Demonstrated experience in microservices architecture and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure).
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

title: Management Trainee Officer (MTO)
education: Master's or 4-year Bachelor's degree from HEC recognized university with minimum 3.0 CGPA or 60% marks.
description: A comprehensive leadership development program designed to groom fresh graduates for core banking operations, branch management, and Islamic banking roles.
requirements: Maximum age limit is 26 years (29 for Masters degree holders).
High academic track record with strong aptitude for Islamic Banking.
Willingness to be posted anywhere in Pakistan.

title: Graduate Trainee Engineer - Chemical
education: B.E / B.Sc in Chemical Engineering accredited by PEC.
description: Assist plant operations engineers in managing fertilizer manufacturing units, ensuring plant safety, efficiency, and environmental compliance at Daharki complex.
requirements: Valid Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC) registration.
Minimum CGPA of 3.0 or equivalent percentage.
Strong analytical and interpersonal competencies.

title: Software Engineer (Dot Net)
education: BS Computer Science / Software Engineering / IT
description: Work on enterprise asset finance and leasing software solutions deployed globally for top-tier financial institutions.
requirements: Hands-on experience with C#, .NET, SQL Server, and Web APIs.
Understanding of OOP principles and design patterns.
Ability to work in agile development teams.

title: Operations Trainee Scheme
education: Bachelor's or Master's Degree from HEC recognized university.
description: Manage branch operations, customer services, and digital banking transactions to provide seamless banking experiences to HBL customers.
requirements: Fresh graduates with exceptional academic records.
Customer-centric mindset and strong communication skills.
Proficiency in office automation and computer literacy.
